scene_prompt.name: Shared Scene / Background
scene_prompt.tooltip: Describe the location, mood, lighting, and initial character arrangement shared by the whole video. Put changing actions and dialogue in Ordered Steps. Spaces and line breaks alone are empty. In T2VA, if this field and every active Ordered Step action/dialogue are empty, ComfyUI blocks the prompt branch as an unfinished draft. Short meaningful text such as `walking` is valid.
scene_prompt.description: Describe the location, mood, lighting, and initial character arrangement shared by the whole video. Put changing actions and dialogue in Ordered Steps. Text containing only spaces or line breaks does not count as content. In T2V, a completely empty draft with no scene, explicit environment setting, or active Ordered Step action/dialogue remains queueable instead of becoming a native input error. Only the h3_prompt branch waits and info reports status=waiting_for_content; no generic scene is invented. Short meaningful text such as `walking` is valid.
scene_prompt.placeholder: Describe the video scene and desired direction

mode.name: H3 Mode
mode.tooltip: Auto follows the actual image connections: none=T2VA, start only=I2VA, end only=L2VA, start+end=FL2VA. Manual T2VA stays fixed and ignores connected images for prompt-mode resolution. Manual I2VA requires a start image, L2VA requires an end image, and FL2VA requires both; if a required image is missing, the node does not switch modes, shows a guidance badge, and quietly waits on the h3_prompt branch. This control determines the dynamic node structure, so external input connections are intentionally not supported. Set it directly on the node.

i2va_preserve_reference_clothing.name: Preserve reference clothing
i2va_preserve_reference_clothing.description: Shown when the effective task is I2VA and a start image is connected. It separately emphasizes preserving clothing, colors, materials, and accessories from the start image; Ordered Steps, shot count, and per-person clothing settings never toggle this value. The selected value is retained while hidden.

duration_seconds.name: Video Duration (s)
duration_seconds.tooltip: Set the target video duration in whole seconds. Main accepts 4-30 seconds; MiniMax H3 officially supports up to 15 seconds, while 16-30 seconds are the node's advanced/local-use range. Timeline and camera-cut bounds follow this duration. Match it to the actual duration in the H3 video-generation node. This control determines the dynamic node structure, so external input connections are intentionally not supported. Set it directly on the node so the visible UI and the value used at Queue execution always stay aligned.
duration_seconds.description: Reference duration for H3 timing. This node accepts 4-30 whole seconds. visual_style.name: Visual Style

visual_style.description: An explicit style is placed at the very beginning of [Shot 1] following the MiniMax H3 guide. Use No Camera Direction when no special camera motion is needed.

scene_translate.name: Descriptive Text Translation

camera_shot_6_target.tooltip: Choose the focus of Shot 6: current action, a person/group, or the full scene.

camera_shot_6_framing.name: Shot 6 Framing
camera_shot_6_framing.tooltip: Framing for Shot 6. Person targets expose portrait/body framing. Non-person targets stay on Auto / fit to scene.

camera_shot_6_motion.name: Shot 6 Camera Motion
camera_shot_6_motion.tooltip: Optional camera motion after Shot 6 begins. Avoid adding extra motion when a framing change alone is sufficient.

camera_shot_6_amplitude.name: Shot 6 Camera Amplitude
camera_shot_6_amplitude.description: Amplitude applied only to Shot 6 camera motion.
camera_shot_6_amplitude.tooltip: Follow Base Settings inherits the top Camera Amplitude. Default · Omit suppresses the amplitude phrase for this Shot. Small/Large overrides it only for this Shot, and only camera motions that support amplitude use the modifier.

camera_shot_6_speed.name: Shot 6 Camera Speed
camera_shot_6_speed.description: Speed applied only to Shot 6 camera motion.
camera_shot_6_speed.tooltip: Follow Base Settings inherits the top Camera Speed. Default · Omit suppresses the speed phrase for this Shot. Slow/Fast overrides it only for this Shot, and only camera motions that support speed use the modifier.
